content: StrategyQuant X (desktop, forex/futures) is the strongest shipped validation suite found: two Monte Carlo tests with 9+ simulation types (trade reshuffling/omission, fast because it reuses existing backtest trades), Walk-Forward optimization plus a Walk-Forward MATRIX with 3D result view, and 'cross checks' - automated robustness gates that can auto-REJECT strategies during generation (additional markets, MC equity-curve families, WF/WF-matrix). BuildAlpha similar. Conclusion: rigorous validation IS shipped, but only in desktop retail-quant tools aimed at forex/futures - not in the AI-first crypto SaaS category.
